creative_brief.video: vertical 9:16 playful stop-motion craft. Tiny wooden table in soft window light. Small unfrosted vanilla cake materialises slice-by-slice 3s. A single candle pops up. At 8s candle lights itself, flame flickers warmly. At 14s paper confetti rains down in slow motion. At 20s a handwritten tag on string drifts past camera: 'for {name}'. At 25s candle bends slightly toward camera as if curious. Final 5s pull back to cozy attic, sun-streaked dust, cake glowing center frame. Pastel cream / soft peach / butter yellow / warm white. NO faces, NO singing-mouth, NO traditional birthday hat. Wes Anderson symmetric framing throughout.
